text: I have been vexed to see husbands hate their wives only because they themselves do them wrong; we should not, at all events, methinks, love them the less for our own faults; they should at least, upon the account of repentance and compassion, be dearer to us.
author: Michel de Montaigne
locator: Book III, Chapter V, Upon Some Verses of Virgil
translation: Charles Cotton, ed. W. C. Hazlitt, 1877
